test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 6 days. B alone can do the same work in 12 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together complete work in 6 days

B alone completes work in 12 days

**Concept used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency ∝ 1 ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 6 and 12 = 12

⇒ Total work = 12 units

⇒ (A + B)’s one day work = 12 ÷ 6 = 2 units

⇒ B’s one day work = 12 ÷ 12 = 1 unit

⇒ A’s one day work = 2 − 1 = 1 unit

⇒ Time taken by A to complete 1 work = 12 ÷ 1 = 12 days

⇒ Double work = 2 × 12 = 24 units

⇒ Time taken by A for double work = 24 ÷ 1

⇒ Time taken = 24 days

**∴ The required time is 24 days.**
